listenings.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Anna Weber. I am a key account manager, and I am based in Stuttgart, in Germany. I am in charge of two German car makers. I work with them every day. I deal with their orders, their prices and their new projects. I do not work with the American market. Daniel does that. I usually join this call on Mondays, but sometimes I travel to the factories. Please, if you have a question for me, send it by email before Friday. Thank you, and nice to meet you all.

Hi, everyone. I am Wei Zhang. I work at our plant in Shanghai, in China. I am a production planner. I plan the production of adhesives for our car makers in Asia. I also deal with shipments to South America, so I work with Fernanda's team a lot. We are in a very different time zone. When you start this call in the morning, it is nine at night here. So sometimes I am tired, and I speak fast. Sorry. If you do not understand me, please ask me again. And please send important questions in writing, by chat or email. That is easier for me.
